headline: Reliance Chemotex submits SEBI dematerialization compliance certificate for Q2 FY27
hook: Routine quarterly filing from Reliance Chemotex
summary: Reliance Chemotex has filed its SEBI dematerialization compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. This is a routine regulatory filing required for listed entities. The document confirms compliance with depository participant regulations regarding share dematerialization. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock experience no direct financial impact from this procedural update.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on shareholders.
